units.source_text: 黄昏已过，天光朦胧暗淡，但见兵部卿亲王斯文一脉地坐着，神情异常艳雅。

en.t: Dusk had passed, and the light of the sky was dim and hazy, but the Prince of Hyobukyo could be seen sitting there with quiet refinement, his expression unusually graceful and elegant.

units.source_text: 内室中的香气随风飘来，其中混着源氏的衣香，气味越发芬芳。

en.t: The fragrance from the inner room drifted in on the wind, mingled with the scent of Genji's robes, making it still more richly perfumed.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王推想玉鬘的容貌一定比他所预期的更美，爱慕之心更加热烈了。

en.t: The Prince of Hyobukyo imagined that Tamakazura's beauty must be even greater than he had expected, and his longing for her grew more ardent.

units.source_text: 他明言直说，向宰相君陈述他对小姐的恋慕之情，句句入情入理，落落大方，完全不是冒冒失失的急色儿口吻，其神态亦与众不同。

en.t: He spoke plainly and directly to Saisho no Kimi of his love for the young lady; every word was reasonable, heartfelt, and dignified, with none of the rash tone of an impatient suitor, and his manner too was quite exceptional.

units.source_text: 源氏偷偷地倾听，颇感兴味。

en.t: Genji listened secretly and found it quite interesting.

units.source_text: 玉鬘笼闭在东面的房间里，横卧在床。

en.t: Tamakazura had shut herself away in the eastern room and was lying on her bed.

units.source_text: 宰相君膝行而入，向她传达亲王的言词。

en.t: Saisho no Kimi came in on her knees and conveyed the prince's words to her.

units.source_text: 源氏叫她转告小姐：“这样招待，实在太沉闷了。

en.t: Genji had her tell the young lady, "This way of receiving him is really much too dull.

units.source_text: 万事须能随机应变，这才像样。

en.t: One must be able to adapt to circumstances in all things; that is the proper way to behave.

units.source_text: 你又不是一个无知无识的小孩。

en.t: You are not an ignorant little child, after all.

units.source_text: 对于像这位亲王之类的人，不必远而避之而叫侍女传言问答。

en.t: With someone like this prince, there is no need to keep your distance and have attendants carry messages back and forth.

units.source_text: 即使你不肯亲口答话，至少也得和他接近些。”

en.t: Even if you will not answer him with your own lips, you should at least come a little closer to him."

units.source_text: 他如此劝导她，但是玉鬘很不高兴。

en.t: He advised her in this way, but Tamakazura was very displeased.

units.source_text: 她想：源氏或许将以劝导为借口而闯进她房间里来，反正一样是讨厌的。

en.t: She thought that Genji might use this advice as an excuse to burst into her room, and in any case it was equally hateful.

units.source_text: 于是她就溜出房间，来到正屋和厢房之间的帷屏旁边，俯伏在那里了。

en.t: So she slipped out of the room, went to the curtain screen between the main house and the side chamber, and lay face down there.
